name: Deakin University
description:
Deakin University is a public university situated in Victoria, Australia. Not only is the university ranked in first place for teaching quality and student support in Victoria, but it is also in the top 1% of universities worldwide across various study areas: including law, education, sport, media studies, nursing and medicine, accounting and finance, and communication.

World-class facilities and award-winning career services attract around 11878 international students from 120 countries worldwide to study here.

What is the Deakin University acceptance rate for International Students?

The La Deakin University acceptance rate is 75%.

highlights.title: Overview
highlights.value:
Established in 1974, Deakin University is one of Australia's most progressive institutions, named after the country's second Prime Minister, Alfred Deakin. It is recognised among the top 1% of universities globally and is known for its "balanced excellence" in both research and teaching.

The university operates through four main faculties: Arts and Education, Business and Law, Health, and Science, Engineering and Built Environment. Deakin is a leader in digital learning, offering a "Cloud Campus" for online students alongside its physical locations.

highlights.title: Student life
highlights.value: You’ll find a thriving student community at Deakin, which has consistently been rated number one for student satisfaction in Victoria for 14 consecutive years. The Deakin University Student Association (DUSA) is the heart of campus life, managing over 120 student clubs and societies ranging from academic groups to cultural and sporting interests. For international students, Deakin offers comprehensive support, including multifaith chaplaincy, medical centres, and dedicated orientation programmes to help you settle into Australian life.

highlights.title: Accommodation
highlights.value:
Deakin provides a variety of on-campus living options designed to foster social connections and academic success. All-inclusive weekly fees cover rent, utilities, and high-speed Wi-Fi, with 24/7 support from residential leaders. If you prefer living off-campus, the university provides an online accommodation finder and support to help you understand your rights as a tenant.

If you’re looking for budget-friendly accommodation options outside the campus, feel free to download our app and check out the Stays feature!

highlights.title: Facilities
highlights.value:
1. Library

Deakin’s state-of-the-art libraries across all campuses provide extensive digital and physical collections. You’ll have access to quiet study zones, group collaboration spaces, and expert support from librarians.

2. Sports

Through DeakinACTIVE, you can access world-class fitness facilities, including gyms with Technogym equipment, group fitness classes, basketball courts, and sports ovals. There are also various social sports teams and a dedicated fitness app to help you stay active.

3. Laboratories

Deakin is home to specialised research and teaching labs, such as the professional motion-capture lab at the Burwood campus and the "living laboratory" for sustainable development at Waurn Ponds.

4. Cafeteria

Each campus features a variety of cafes and food outlets where you can grab a quick meal or coffee. Popular spots are integrated into the campus to ensure you have convenient dining options between classes.
